verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs directly evidence the story: `.remember` ingests conversation/session data (including session-scoped writes via session_id), `.recall` performs semantic/classified search over stored memory, and `.improve` explicitly bridges short-term session memory into permanent memory for cross-session persistence. MCP integration also lets AI assistants use this persistent memory across sessions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of retrieval quality or recall accuracy in practice (only vendor docs, plus one skeptical community note about setup friction at small scale) and no first-party benchmark of semantic search precision.
